findings.evidence: Lines 104-107 and 117-119 of the file; rubric: "Docstrings describe the object or result, not the proof."
findings.fix: Keep the first sentence of the instance docstring (what the scaling is and why `Dipole` carries it); move the `map_add'`/`apply_symm_apply` justification to a `--` comment on the term. At 117-119, either drop the doc-comment or reduce it to the user-visible fact that the endpoint projections hold definitionally.
findings.issue: The `Module ℝ Dipole` instance docstring explains the proof of the `map_add'` field ("that addition is `d + d' = equivProd.symm (equivProd d + equivProd d')` (`Equiv.addCommGroup`), so `equivProd` preserves it by `Equiv.apply_symm_apply`"). Same category at lines 117-119, whose section doc-comment exists only to justify why the lemmas below are `rfl`.

findings.evidence: Lines 76-78, 109-111, 113-115 have no `/-- -/`; by contrast every neighbouring result (`rapidity_self`, `strictAntiOn_rapidity`, `rapidity_pos_iff`) is documented, and the PR description lists these two iff lemmas among the deliverables.
findings.fix: Add one-line docstrings stating the order reversal (`rapidity x₀ x < rapidity x₀ x'` exactly when `x' < x`, for positive momentum fractions and `x₀ ≠ 0`) and, for line 76, that rapidity splits as `log x₀ - log x` away from zero.
findings.issue: `rapidity_lt_rapidity_iff_gt` and `rapidity_le_rapidity_iff_ge` carry no docstring, although they are the usable form of the roadmap's antitonicity target and the ones re-exported to DIS at lines 167-170; `rapidity_eq_log_sub_log` (line 76) is likewise undocumented despite its two side conditions.

summary: Docstrings are accurate and the module headers are substantive, but two doc-comments in Coordinates.lean document the proof/construction rather than the object, and the main ordering corollaries in Rapidity.lean are undocumented.
